items.source:
By default this is set to "UTF-8". If changed from this default,
the "Content-Type" header will have a "charset" parameter that specifies
the character set used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为"UTF-8"。如果从该默认值更改，则"Content-Type"标头将包含一个指定所用字符集的"charset"参数。

items.source: Prepare the MediaType to use by adding "boundary" and "charset" parameters to the given mediaType or "multipart/form-data" otherwise by default.
items.translation: 通过向给定的mediaType添加"boundary"和"charset"参数来准备要使用的MediaType，否则默认为"multipart/form-data"。

items.source: THe default charset used by the writer.
items.translation: writer 使用的默认字符集。

items.source: Constructor with the list of supported media types.
items.translation: 带有支持的媒体类型列表的构造函数。

items.source: Return the configured charset for part headers.
items.translation: 返回部分头部的配置字符集。

items.source: Support class for multipart HTTP message writers.
items.translation: 支持多部分 HTTP 消息写入器的支持类。

items.source:
Set the character set to use for part headers such as
"Content-Disposition" (and its filename parameter).
items.translation: 将字符集设置为用于部分标题（如 "Content-Disposition" 及其文件名参数）的字符集。
